title: GIF export: finite Loop count ignored (plays once instead of N times)
description: FIXED. Root cause: useExportHandlers.ts handleExportGifConfirm derived gifenc repeat as `options.loopForever ? 0 : -1`; gifenc writes the NETSCAPE2.0 application-extension (the loop-count carrier) ONLY when repeat>=0, so -1 emitted NO extension and any finite loopCount was discarded -> GIF played once. Fix: extracted pure helper gifLoopRepeat({loopForever,loopCount}) = loopForever?0:Math.max(1,loopCount) and use it for repeat, so a finite count is threaded into gifenc.writeFrame on frame 0 -> the NETSCAPE2.0 sub-block now encodes N (0=forever). Test: packages/authoring-ui/src/__tests__/gifExportLoopCount.test.ts — derivation cases + end-to-end encodes a real 2-frame GIF via gifenc and parses the NETSCAPE2.0 2-byte LE loop count (finite 3->3, 7->7, forever->0, and regression: old repeat=-1 -> no extension present). Verification run: vitest gifExportLoopCount.test.ts = 6 passed; @flash/authoring-ui full = 771 passed; @flash/swf = 1451 passed; @flash/core = 5323 passed / 2 failed (pre-existing ENOENT on un-tracked fixtures/flash8-empty.fla, unrelated). Builds green.
